name: 93277 · Visalia, CA
findings: ZIP 93277 (Visalia) has 161 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93277 (Visalia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93277 (Visalia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 65 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
